title: The Lancashire Creamery Vanilla Milkshake & Wafer 10ml E-Liquid
description: Vanilla Milkshake and Wafer by Lancashire Creamery blends the indulgent taste of classic American-style Milkshake with the comforting sweetness of crisp Wafer. The Vanilla note is soft, velvety and creamy, delivering a rounded sweetness with a gentle, satisfying finish. Subtle bakery tones from the Wafer layer in a sweet cereal-like finish, creating a mellow dessert vape that tastes both nostalgic and refined. This nicotine salt e-liquid provides a smooth, tactile throat hit with fast-absorbing nicotine, ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, it performs excellently in low-powered pod kits, vape pens, and starter devices. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths, it caters to a range of nicotine preferences. Lancashire Creamery specialises in dessert-inspired e-liquids made in the UK, focusing on layered, satisfying flavour profiles that bring pudding-shop indulgence to everyday vaping.
